title: dianthus serratus var. scaber
intro: Dianthus serratus var. scaber, commonly known as Toothed Pink Clover, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. Its therapeutic actions include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as skin irritations and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Toothed Pink Clover include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
